title: Market value effects of acquisitions involving internet firms: a resource‐based analysis

rival_explanations: Prior strategic alliances of the offline acquirer with online firms already provided access to the same valuable online resources, so the acquisition yields no incremental gains

context.industry_setting: acquisitions involving Internet (online) firms — offline firms acquiring online firms and online firms acquiring other online firms
context.country_region: United States (acquirers listed on Nasdaq and NYSE)
context.sample_size: 798 acquisitions (363 online firms acquiring online firms + 435 online firms acquired by offline firms)

data_sources.name: Thomson Financial Securities Data M&A Database

analyses.label: Table 1 - Event study results
analyses.sample: 1,029 acquisition events (363 online acquiring online, 435 online acquired by offline); publicly traded acquirers 1995-2001

key_ivs.name: type of acquisition
key_ivs.measure: acquisition group classification: offline-online (Hypothesis 1), online-online (Hypothesis 2), offline-offline (control group); firms classified as 'online' or 'offline' by two independent raters
key_ivs.source: Thomson Financial Securities Data M&A Database
